[[Fist of the Titans|Fists of the Titans]] spawn along with a [[Hand of the Titans]] when a [[Risen Ashen Hulk]] is killed, though they may also be found roaming on their own. They are powerful and must be eliminated quickly, as too many will quickly overwhelm the party. It is advisable to [[interrupt]] their [[Healing Signet]] skill, as they will use it whenever possible.
